apps/slack: Procedures for the Slack app (post messages, channels, users, search, etc.).
domains/finance: Procedures and playbooks for finance-domain tasks (invoices, budgets, reporting, etc.).
domains/hr: Procedures and playbooks for hr-domain tasks (onboarding, reviews, records, etc.).
domains/marketing: Procedures and playbooks for marketing-domain tasks (campaigns, lists, content, etc.).
domains/operations: Procedures and playbooks for operations-domain tasks (logistics, scheduling, tracking, etc.).
domains/sales: Procedures and playbooks for sales-domain tasks (CRM records, pipelines, outreach, etc.).
domains/support: Procedures and playbooks for support-domain tasks (tickets, SLAs, escalations, etc.).
This is the workflow playbook for marketing-domain tasks (campaigns, lists, content, etc.).

This is the operating procedure for the Google Sheets app (rows, lookups, worksheets, updates, etc.).

- Open every worksheet of a spreadsheet (get_spreadsheet_by_id lists them) and read each with get_many_rows; policy/config/updates/blackout tabs override the base rules.
- Write status/label cells using the exact vocabulary in the rules or existing rows.
This is the operating procedure for the Google Drive app (find, upload, move, share files, etc.).

This is the operating procedure for the Gmail app (send, find, label, threads, drafts, etc.).

- Policy lives here often: list the inbox broadly (gmail_find_email, no narrow keyword, 50+ results) and read policy/update emails before acting. A narrow keyword search returning nothing does not mean no policy exists; check Slack and Drive next.
- Send one email per recipient when asked to notify each person. Put required tracking codes, IDs and exact source values in the body.

7. Include tracking code RETRO-812-Q4 in the subject line of the retrospective email.

Thanks,

messages.subject: Campaign Retrospective Guidelines - RETRO-812-Q4
messages.body_plain:
Hi team,

Please follow these guidelines for the Q4 campaign retrospective:

1. Only include VALIDATED campaign data. Exclude any rows whose notes mention pending validation or unvalidated data.
2. Campaigns marked as cancelled in notes should be excluded entirely.
3. If a row's notes say results are folded into another campaign, do NOT report it separately.
4. If a row's notes override the actual figure (e.g., cleaned number vs raw), use the number from the notes.
5. Achievement threshold: campaigns at or above 80% of goal count as 'met', below 80% count as 'missed'.
6. For each campaign reported, calculate the achievement percentage (actual / goal * 100) and include it.
7. Include tracking code RETRO-812-Q4 in the subject line of the retrospective email.

Thanks,
Ops

messages.subject: New Event: Content Calendar Review
messages.body_plain: Team scheduled a 45-minute Content Calendar Review on March 6 at 3:00 PM.

messages.subject: Re: Co-marketing proposal
messages.body_plain: Thanks for sending over the draft. Our team is reviewing and will circle back by Thursday.

messages.subject: Weekly social performance summary
messages.body_plain: This week: 45 posts scheduled, 38 published, 7 in queue. Top post: 1.2k impressions on LinkedIn.

messages.subject: Social media takeover — confirmed
messages.body_plain: Confirmed for the Instagram takeover on March 12. I'll send a content brief by Friday.

messages.subject: Link exchange proposal
messages.body_plain: We noticed your blog on SaaS marketing. Would you be open to a reciprocal backlink placement?

messages.subject: Case study interview — scheduling
messages.body_plain: Happy to participate in the case study. Can we do next Wednesday at 2 PM? I have 30 minutes available.

messages.subject: CMI Digest: Content Strategy Trends for Q2
messages.body_plain: Pillar-page strategy drives 3x organic traffic versus standalone blog posts.

messages.subject: Daily Traffic Snapshot — March 3
messages.body_plain: Yesterday: 3,420 sessions (+8% DoD), 142 MQLs, 28 demo requests. Top source: Organic Search (44%).

messages.subject: Creative assets for March campaign ready
messages.body_plain: Hi, the display ad creatives for the March awareness campaign are ready for review. 5 variants attached.

messages.subject: Re: Joint webinar — agenda draft
messages.body_plain: Updated agenda attached. I moved the product demo section to the second half. Let me know if this works.

messages.subject: New Course: Advanced HubSpot Reporting
messages.body_plain: Enroll now in our 2-hour course on custom dashboards and attribution reporting.

messages.subject: Weekly Dashboard: Traffic & Conversion
messages.body_plain: Traffic up 9% WoW. Blog organic sessions +14%. Conversion rate steady at 3.2%. Full dashboard attached.

messages.subject: Workflow alert: 12 contacts entered nurture sequence
messages.body_plain: 12 new contacts entered your 'Content Download Nurture' workflow in the last 24 hours.

messages.subject: Influencer campaign — deliverables update
messages.body_plain: All 4 influencer posts have been published. Engagement so far: 2.4k likes, 380 comments, 120 shares.

messages.subject: Webinar partnership — follow-up
messages.body_plain: Hi, following up on the webinar co-host opportunity. Can we finalize the topic list by Monday?
